items.one_liner: Reduck provides an MCP-based platform that enables AI agents to automate web interactions on sites without formal APIs.
items.summary: Reduck has raised $3 million to develop Reduck MCP, a platform designed to bridge the gap for AI agents interacting with websites lacking APIs. The platform allows agents to discover, execute, and generate browser-automation scripts using the Model Context Protocol. It currently hosts over 1,200 automation scripts across 250 websites to facilitate agentic web tasks.
items.bottom_line: You can now offload browser-automation script management to Reduck MCP, allowing agents to execute or generate web interactions without custom API integrations.

items.title: Multiple Arbitrary File Read/Write via SQL Injection
items.one_liner: A low-privileged SQL injection in FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer allows for arbitrary command execution and file manipulation.
items.summary: A critical SQL injection vulnerability (CWE-89) has been discovered in Fortinet's FortiAnalyzer and FortiManager products, including their cloud variants. The flaw allows a low-privileged user to execute arbitrary commands or perform unauthorized file read/write operations via specially crafted requests. Fortinet has acknowledged the internal discovery of the bug and published the initial advisory on October 13, 2026.
items.bottom_line: Administrators of Fortinet management platforms should check for available patches to prevent low-privileged users from escalating to arbitrary command execution.

claims.text: The SQL injection allows low-privileged users to execute arbitrary commands.
